name: Indianapolis Public Schools
studentCountAsOf: Official IPS District Overview reviewed August 2026; the district says it serves more than 30,000 students
calendarType: Student and staff calendar with an early-August opening, a full October fall break, three student asynchronous-learning days, four quarters, and separate pre-year professional-learning dates
seoTitle: Indianapolis Public Schools Calendar: IPS Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Reviewed Indianapolis Public Schools calendars with IPS breaks, asynchronous learning days, quarter dates, staff planning days, official PDFs, and ICS files.
districtFact: IPS publishes a combined Student & Staff School Calendar. Each reviewed year lists 180 student days, including three asynchronous-learning days, and 192 staff days; that distinction matters when planning childcare because an asynchronous day is instructional but not a normal in-person school day.
profileDisclaimer: IPS describes itself as serving more than 30,000 students across more than 70 schools. Those rounded figures include a portfolio with district-managed and Innovation Network schools and can change as programs or operators change.

about.title: The IPS Calendar Counts Three Asynchronous Student Days
about.content: In both reviewed years, two Student Progress Conference dates and one staff professional-learning date are labeled Student Asynchronous Learning. IPS includes one asynchronous day in semester 1 and two in semester 2, for three of the published 180 student days. Students work remotely or asynchronously rather than following a normal in-person day.

about.title: Staff Begin Well Before the First Student Day
about.content: The combined calendar starts in July with New IPS Teacher Induction, teacher work days, and districtwide or school-based professional learning. The student year begins August 4 in 2025–26 and August 10 in 2026–27, so families should not mistake a colored July staff date for a student attendance date.

about.title: A Full Fall Break Shapes the Early-Start Calendar
about.content: IPS opens in early August and schedules a five-weekday Fall Break in October, followed by Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring breaks. Quarter boundaries do not always align with a Monday-to-Friday attendance week, so the exact quarter ranges are preserved from each official calendar rather than inferred from the break dates.

about.title: The Printable Folder Covers District and Innovation Calendars
about.content: The IPS calendar hub labels its Google Drive collection Printable District & Innovation Network Calendars. These pages use the English IPS Student & Staff School Calendar for districtwide dates. An Innovation Network school may publish a different annual calendar, event schedule, or operating decision, so families should confirm the calendar named for their assigned school.

about.title: Four Enrollment Zones Organize a Broad School Portfolio
about.content: IPS says every Indianapolis address falls within one of four enrollment zones. Families may apply to schools outside their zone through Enroll Indy, but the zone affects neighborhood options and transportation. The district highlights more than 70 schools, eight elementary and middle-school education models, and more than 32 high-school pathways.

about.title: Innovation Network Weather Decisions Are School-Specific
about.content: The IPS inclement-weather policy says the district aims to notify families before 6 a.m. about delays, cancellations, or early dismissals. It also states that each Innovation Network School makes its own weather decision. On a weather day, check both the IPS alert and the student's school communication before relying on the annual calendar.

calendarNotes: Use the IPS Student & Staff School Calendar for districtwide instructional dates, then confirm the assigned school's calendar if the school is in the Innovation Network. The annual sheet distinguishes no-school holidays, staff professional-development days with no school, Student Progress Conferences with asynchronous learning, and records days after each semester. The three asynchronous dates are counted among the 180 student days and should not be treated as vacations. July induction, professional learning, and teacher work dates apply to staff groups before students begin. Quarter ranges are academic reporting periods, not automatic closures. School events, athletics, enrollment deadlines, transportation updates, emergency closures, and Innovation Network operating decisions can appear outside the printable annual calendar.

planningTips.title: Planning with the Indianapolis IPS Calendar
content: Save the first student day, not the first colored staff date; IPS staff activity begins weeks before students return.
Plan for three asynchronous-learning days each reviewed year. Students have assignments, but families should not expect a regular in-person schedule.
Keep Fall Break separate from the end of Quarter 1. IPS prints both, and their boundaries are not interchangeable.
After Winter Break, use the First Student Day of Second Semester shown on the annual calendar rather than assuming classes resume on January 2.
If the student attends an Innovation Network school, verify that school's own printable calendar and weather notices before booking travel or care.
Complete the annual transportation opt-in in PowerSchool when eligible for an IPS bus; the transportation page says registration is required each year.
Treat the MySchoolDates ICS as a one-time snapshot and recheck IPS for revisions, weather decisions, school events, athletics, and transportation changes.

districtFaqs.q: When does Indianapolis Public Schools start?
districtFaqs.a: IPS starts on a different August date each year. Students began August 4 in 2025–26 and begin August 10 in 2026–27. July and early-August staff dates occur before the first student day.

districtFaqs.q: Does IPS have a Fall Break?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The reviewed calendars show a five-weekday Fall Break: October 13–17 in 2025 and October 12–16 in 2026. Confirm the assigned school's calendar if it is an Innovation Network school.

districtFaqs.q: Are IPS asynchronous-learning days counted as school days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Each reviewed IPS calendar counts three asynchronous days within the 180 student days: one in semester 1 and two in semester 2. They are instructional days, not ordinary in-person attendance days or vacations.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Indianapolis IPS schools use the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. The IPS printable collection includes District and Innovation Network calendars. Use the IPS Student & Staff School Calendar for districtwide dates, then check the assigned school or operator for any separate calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Do Innovation Network schools follow IPS weather closures?
districtFaqs.a: IPS says each Innovation Network School makes its own weather decision. Families should check the school's direct communication even when the IPS homepage posts a district delay, closure, or early dismissal.

districtFaqs.q: How many student and staff days are on the IPS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Both reviewed calendars list 180 student days and 192 staff days. The student total includes three asynchronous-learning days; the staff total also includes induction, professional learning, teacher work, and records dates.
